title: What will be said during Germany vs Curaçao on ITV?
description:
Words must be spoken by a ITV Sports presenter, commentator, or pundit during the live broadcast of Germany vs Curaçao (Fifa World Cup, 14th June).  
Covers from when the whistle is blown at kickoff, until the game concludes. 
On-screen graphics, crowd noise, and replays of non-ITV footage do not count. Adverts not included.
